title: Set up auto-expiry policies for our ALB and CloudFront logs
body: They include user IP addresses, which count as personally identifiable information for the purposes of DPA and GDPR. We should auto-expire them after 14 days or similar; it's very rare for us to even look at them!
author: Participant 1
scope: Retrieval-time original issue/comment Markdown from GitHub's structured page data; full discussion only when count and pagination checks pass. Closure time is not available from this endpoint. Linked material is stored separately.
retrieval_method: GitHub public issue page embedded original Markdown
